snippet.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 - Fight Your Way Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Create your ultimate Avatar and fight your way through DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3!

Choose from six unique Avatar races, including the new Android race, and customize your combat style with Fighting Styles, Soul Assist, Awoken Skills, Soul Switch, Abilities, and more.

With more than 130 characters, including non-playable characters, to learn from, build the fighter that matches how you want to move, transform, attack, and dominate every battle.
